verdict.rationale: No evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec for the Agentic Commerce APIs, and a probe of the usual OpenAPI and Swagger paths on docs.stripe.com returned 404 on every candidate. The machine-readable assets that do exist (llms.txt, markdown docs, the skills JSON index, the MPP markdown spec index) are documentation or agent-guidance artifacts, not API schemas. The ACP specification is described as open source but not as a downloadable machine-readable schema, so it is not credited here.
